Method of Attack: Phishing emails with Excel XLSM attachments containing malicious macros that execute PowerShell commands to create scheduled tasks impersonating Firefox browser updater
Downloading and launching a backdoor in memory connecting to command and control server to execute or deploy further malware payloads
Embedding and launching malware payloads from XSLT stylesheets
Using Microsoft Exchange server-side component installed via Desired State Configuration to convert Exchange server into malware-distribution server
Impacted Systems: Defense industry systems in Ukraine and Eastern Europe
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious Excel XLSM attachments
Scheduled tasks impersonating Firefox browser updater
Microsoft Exchange server with Desired State Configuration module
Backdoor command and control server communication
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing emails with Excel XLSM attachments
Scheduled task named as Firefox browser updater
Base64-encoded Windows executable loaded via Desired State Configuration
Use of Rclone tool for data exfiltration
Malware payloads launched from XSLT stylesheets
Samples shared with cybersecurity companies and VirusTotal detections
